audit.why: EVEN 6/10 fits 49.63% over 1892 games: you own level 3 and the first-item window, he owns 4-5, the rest is even.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows disagreed with the packet chart even though the prose on those exact rows agreed with it: Level 2 said Renekton (prose: 'Level 2 stays even'), Levels 4-5 said Skill (prose: 'tilting the tempo his way'), 2+ items said Renekton (prose: 'leveling the duel back out to even').
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Renekton, Zaahen, Skill, Renekton, Skill]. The page was rendering a different answer than its own why text on three rows.
audit.corrected: Level 2 to Skill, Levels 4-5 to Zaahen, 2+ items to Skill, as matched pairs with the why lines restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Zaahen ability is described anywhere — the whole matchup says 'Ultimate' and 'his kit'. His passive revive is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's kit: passive Determination stacks give bonus AD and, when filled, let him REVIVE. Q slashes twice, heals him, resets his auto, and can be recast for a knock-up (10/9/8/7/6). W stabs and pulls you in (14/13.5/13/12.5/12, 850 range). E dashes and deals percent-health damage (10/9.5/9/8.5/8). R stabs down and heals off the damage dealt (110/95/80). The revive alone changes every all-in decision and it was absent.
audit.corrected: State the revive, the two heals, and the E/W cooldowns as the trade timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect confirmed: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Every 'wait for X' line was abstract ('his answer', 'his kit'). The E dash at 10s and the W pull at 14s are the concrete timers a player can actually count.
audit.corrected: His E dash is 10s and his W pull 14s — commit in the gap after the dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentions anti-heal despite two healing abilities plus a revive.
audit.why: Q and R both carry the heal flag, and E deals percent-health damage so stacking HP is not the answer either.

edits.before: E-in trades begin — bank 50 fury before you slice. Only take the trade when Zaahen's Ultimate is down.
edits.after: Even at 2 — bank 50 fury and farm; his Q is a 10s auto reset that heals, so short trades only.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ultimate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His Q, W pull and E dash are all up now and he can break your stun window — shrink commitments and farm around his cooldowns.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Zaahen carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: his sustain and stats catch your falloff. Zaahen carry threat 8/10 — take fights with your team, not alone.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his Q and E are online and he can disengage your stun, tilting the tempo his way.
edits.after: His E dash is 10s and his W pull 14s — commit only in the gap after he spends the dash.

edits.before: His big cooldown. Burst around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His R heals him off the damage it deals — 110s at rank 1, so bait it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: At full Determination he revives — check his stacks before you commit.

edits.before: Track Zaahen's Ultimate: His big cooldown. Burst around it. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: His Q heals and knocks up on recast, his R heals — Executioner's before you all-in at 6.

notes: packet.enemyAbilities is null for Zaahen, so no ability NAMES are confirmed by the packet. The _missing-interactions data names Q 'The Darkin Glaive', E 'Aureate Rush' and R 'Grim Deliverance', but that is a different source from the kit file and the W is unnamed there, so I referred to slots rather than risk shipping a wrong name — see questionsForUser. Everything else (cooldowns, heals, revive, percent-health E) is straight from the kit file. Chart edits are one atomic group of three matched pairs; on all three the page's own why text already agreed with the packet and only the rendered side was wrong.
